q: How many layers are in the OSI model?
why: OSI reference model-এ সাতটি layer; TCP/IP সাধারণত চারটি।

q: Which layer is responsible for routing?
why: Network layer L3 logical IP addressing ও routing করে।

q: The data unit at the Data Link layer is a…
why: L2 frame; L3 packet; L4 TCP segment; L1 bit।

q: A router operates at OSI layer…
why: Router destination IP ও routing table ব্যবহার করে L3-এ।

q: Which device breaks up broadcast domains?
why: Router broadcast forward করে না default-এ; VLAN-ও logical broadcast boundary।

q: How many bits are in an IPv4 address?
why: চার octet × আট bit = 32।

q: How many bits are in an IPv6 address?
why: আট hex group × ষোল bit = 128।

q: The default subnet mask of Class B is…
why: Historical Class B default prefix/16।

q: Which is a private IP address?
why: 10/8 private। 172 private শুধু 16–31 second octet; 192.168 private, 192.169 নয়।

q: The loopback address is…
why: 127/8 loopback block; 127.0.0.1 localhost।

q: How many usable hosts in a /26 network?
The subnet mask for /28 is…
why: Last octet 11110000 = 240; 28 network bits।

q: Which protocol resolves IP to MAC?
why: Local IPv4 next-hop IP → MAC হলো ARP।

q: DNS uses port…
why: DNS সাধারণত UDP/TCP port 53।

q: HTTPS uses port…
why: HTTPS default443, HTTP 80।

q: Which is connectionless?
why: UDP connection setup handshake ছাড়াই datagram পাঠায়।

q: The TCP handshake has how many steps?
why: SYN, SYN+ACK, ACK—তিন ধাপ।

q: UDP header size is…
why: Source port 2+destination2+length 2+checksum2 = 8 bytes।

q: Which protocol is used to send email?
why: SMTP send; POP 3/IMAP retrieve/sync; SNMP monitor।

q: DHCP process is known as…
why: Discover, Offer, Request, Acknowledge।

q: Which topology needs n(n−1)/2 links?
why: প্রতিটি unordered device pair-এর জন্যএক link; full mesh।

q: In star topology the single point of failure is…
why: Central hub/switch নষ্ট হলে তার star-এর সব endpoint বিচ্ছিন্ন।

q: Wired Ethernet uses…
why: বইয়ের legacy shared half-duplex context-এ CD। Modern switched full-duplex Ethernet-এ CSMA/CD লাগে না।

q: Maximum efficiency of pure ALOHA is…
why: Pure max1/(2e)≈18.4%; slotted1/e≈36.8%।

q: 10BASE5 has a maximum segment length of…
why: 5 মানে 500 m thick coax; 10BASE2 বাস্তবে 185 m।

q: Manchester encoding always has a transition…
why: Mandatory mid-bit transition থেকে clock recover হয়।

q: Which line code has no DC component?
why: AMI-তে 1 alternating positive/negative; দীর্ঘ সময় average zero।

q: PCM stands for…
why: Sample → quantize → encode।

q: The first step of PCM is…
why: আগে analog signal-এর samples মাপা হয়।

q: Nyquist sampling rate must be at least…
why: Ideal bandlimited signal-এর minimum twice highest frequency।

q: A telephone digital voice channel is…
why: 8000 samples/s × 8 bits = 64000 bps; DS-0 context।

q: ASK changes the signal’s…
why: A = Amplitude Shift Keying।

q: QAM changes…
why: Quadrature Amplitude Modulation-এ amplitude+phase constellation।

q: FDM divides the link by…
why: Frequency Division Multiplexing পৃথক frequency band।

q: WDM is used with…
why: Wavelength/colour দিয়ে optical signals multiplex।

q: Which medium is immune to EMI?
why: Fibre data বহন করে light-এ, electrical current-এ নয়।

q: Cat6 supports a bandwidth of…
why: Cat6 rating250 MHz; Cat6a500 MHz। MHz rating≠Mbps speed।

q: The connector used with UTP is…
why: LAN twisted pair connector প্রচলিত নামে RJ-45 (8P8C)।

q: Fibre works on the principle of…
why: Core-cladding boundary-তে light guided থাকে।

q: Microwave transmission typically requires…
why: Typical terrestrial microwave link-এ clear line-of-sight দরকার।

q: Circuit switching is traditionally used in…
why: Traditional PSTN dedicated circuit reserve করত।

q: Which is a store-and-forward technique?
why: Message switching সম্পূর্ণ message store করে forward। Packet switching-ও store-and-forward হতে পারে, কিন্তু option-এনেই।

q: CRC uses which operation?
why: Modulo2 division-এ carry/borrow ছাড়া XOR।

q: Simple parity cannot detect…
why: জোড় সংখ্যক bit flip-এ parity অপরিবর্তিত থাকে।

q: Standard Hamming code can correct…
why: Single-bit error syndrome দিয়ে locate/correct; সব multiple error নয়।

q: Which retransmits only the damaged frame?
why: Selective Repeat শুধু missing/corrupt frame ফেরতচায়; GBN পরেরগুলোও।

q: RIP uses which metric?
why: RIP route distance hop count-এমাপে।

q: OSPF uses which algorithm?
why: OSPF link-state database থেকে shortest path first।

q: RIP’s maximum usable hop count is…
why: 15 maximum; 16 infinity/unreachable।

q: BGP is which type of protocol?
why: Inter-AS routing-এ BGP exterior gateway/path-vector protocol।

q: Which is an asymmetric algorithm?
why: RSA public/private pair; অন্যতিনটি symmetric।

q: A digital signature uses the sender’s…
why: Sign sender private, verify sender public।

q: How many unique pairwise keys for n users in symmetric crypto?
why: প্রতি user pair-এরজন্যএক shared secret key।

q: Which attack is passive?
why: Sniffing কেবল observe; অন্যগুলোসাধারণত alter/disrupt।

q: Wi-Fi is defined by…
why: IEEE802.11 WLAN; 802.3Ethernet।

q: Classic Bluetooth piconet supports how many active peripherals?
why: বইয়ের BR/EDR classic model-এ one central+up to7active peripherals; BLE-তে generalize করবেন না।

q: Which generation introduced SMS?
why: 2G digital GSM যুগে SMS।

q: GSM uses which access method?
why: Frequency channel ও time slot দুটোতেই user ভাগ হয়।

q: Which is NOT in IPv6?
why: IPv6 broadcast-এরবদলে multicast ব্যবহারকরে।

q: Bandwidth of a channel from 200 Hz to 3400 Hz is…
why: B = fhigh−flow = 3400−200 = 3200 Hz।
